name: Laurean Rugambwa
role: First modern Black African Catholic Cardinal
contribution: A Tanzanian Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Dar es Salaam from 1968 to 1992.
legacy: He was made a cardinal in 1960 by Pope John XXIII, becoming the first such native African.

checks.lead: Laurean Rugambwa (12 July 1912 – 8 December 1997) was a Tanzanian Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Dar es Salaam from 1968 to 1992. He was made a cardinal in 1960 by Pope John XXIII, becoming the first such native African.
